#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int N = n + m;
    vector<ll> fact(N + 1), invfact(N + 1), inv(N + 1);

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD;

    inv[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) inv[i] = MOD - MOD / i * inv[MOD % i] % MOD;

    invfact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) invfact[i] = invfact[i-1] * inv[i] % MOD;

    // compute phaseSize
    ll phase = 1;
    ll p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = p * (n - i) % MOD * inv[n + m - i] % MOD;
        phase = (phase + p) % MOD;
    }

    ll ans = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        ll sign = ((k + 1) & 1) ? MOD - 1 : 1;
        ll numPhases = (ll)(m + k) * inv[k] % MOD;
        ll term = sign * fact[n] % MOD * invfact[k] % MOD * invfact[n - k] % MOD;
        term = term * numPhases % MOD;
        term = term * phase % MOD;
        ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
    }

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
